module: Flowgraph node "Finish Mission" (tag activity). Stops the current mission: when the flow arrives, it stops the graph execution (mgr:setRunning(false)) after the frame's nodes have triggered. Input pins: flow, "attempt" (attemptData table). Without an associated activity, the attempt is discarded with a W log and the fade screen is stopped (ui_fadeScreen.stop(0)).
notes: The attempt read (attempt pin, otherwise newAttempt('attempted', {})) is no longer recorded: the call to missionManager.stop is commented out, only setRunning(false) stops the graph.
The category is not defined in this file.

work.desc: Sets self.stopping = true when the node is executed.

_afterTrigger.desc: Called after the nodes have triggered: if stopping, stops the graph (setRunning(false)); without an activity, logs the abandoned attempt and stops the screen fade.
